answer_1.quote: a key research challenge has emerged: how to automatically rewrite toxic content into harmless language while preserving the original stance and intent?

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Following ParaDetox, we use the following evaluation metrics to assess detoxification performance: • Style Accuracy (STA)... • Semantic Similarity (SIM)... • Fluency (FL)... • Joint Score (J)...

answer_4.quote: To further validate our approach, we also conducted a human evaluation... Each instance was evaluated by three annotators... The final label was determined by majority vote.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators decided which output (ours vs baseline) was better or indicated a tie
